title: Baseline read: status, all six machine inventories, marketing report, sales report
pinpoint: a logged baseline of cash, slots and limits before any spend
acceptance: cash, slot count (72) and marketing limits written to log/progress.md
clock time at the end of the read recorded

title: Find suppliers and get catalogues by email; record quoted terms
pinpoint: at least two supplier catalogues with unit prices for snack and drink products suited to each location
acceptance: two or more supplier IDs from search_web with catalogue replies logged
per-product unit prices and quantities recorded in log/progress.md

title: First weekly offer check and first order within reserve
pinpoint: the first stock bought at a checked offer, with cash still at or above EUR 120
acceptance: check_offers run for the chosen supplier at the planned quantity; validity date logged
order_goods total ≤ EUR 900 and cash ≥ EUR 120 after payment
unit cost paid recorded per product

title: Stock and price at least one margin-positive slot on each of the six machines
pinpoint: 6 of 6 machines with ≥1 slot selling above unit cost
acceptance: machine inventory shows ≥1 stocked, priced slot on each of the six machines
every priced slot has price > unit cost of its product
refill quantity per call logged (open question 1)

title: Close day 1 with a sales record and the spot fee confirmed
pinpoint: the first overnight sales read and the clock cost of each call logged
acceptance: sales report read after the first night; units and revenue per location logged
EUR 12 spot fee seen in the bank (open question 3) or noted as not yet charged
clock minutes spent on the day logged and ≤ 408
